# omadafusion_admin_user (Resource)

A local controller account (Account). Cloud (TP-Link ID) accounts are invited by email and are not managed here. The password cannot be read back, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected; it is stored in state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "helpdesk_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# A read-only account for an outside helper, limited to one site.
resource "omadafusion_admin_user" "helpdesk" {
  name     = "helpdesk"
  password = var.helpdesk_password
  role     = "viewer"
  sites    = ["Default"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Login name.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Login password. The controller rejects simple passwords (errorCode -30105); mix letters, digits and a symbol.
- `role` (String) `super_admin`, `admin` or `viewer`.

### Optional

- `alerts` (Boolean) Send alert emails to this account.
- `sites` (Set of String) Site names the account may manage. Omit for all sites (including future ones).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) User ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# User ID. Set the password in config; the next apply sends it.
terraform import omadafusion_admin_user.helpdesk 64f0c0ffee00000000000013
```
